acquisition_method.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent mode to automatically switch between MS and MS/MS acquisition.

cleavage_agent.evidence: After the last wash 50 µl of ammonium bicarbonate buffer with 1 µg trypsin (Promega) was added to both FASP-processed and sepharose-processed samples, and incubated overnight at 37°C.

collision_energy.evidence: General mass spectrometry conditions were: electrospray voltage 2.1 kV; no sheath and auxiliary gas flow, heated capillary temperature of 250oC, normalized HCD collision energy 25%.

fragmentation_method.evidence: The method used allowed sequential isolation of the most intense multiply-charged ions, up to ten, depending on signal intensity, for fragmentation on the HCD cell using high-energy collision dissociation at a target value of 100,000 charges or maximum acquisition time of 100 ms.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Peptides were analyzed on Qexactive plus Orbitrap mass spectrometer coupled to Easy-nLC1000 liquid chromatographer (both ThermoFisher Scientific).

ptm.evidence: Parameters were set as follows: no fixed modification; protein N-acetylation and methionine oxidation as variable modifications.
